crossRefs.note: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it, until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of…
This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like…
You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater…
Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
translations.bsb: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.”
translations.kjv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
translations.asv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
